title: Table that turns into place
description: A word table that turns into place: rows flip down out of the dark one after another, a line of light scans the table top to bottom, and the gold column glows behind its cells. The scan comes back now and then while the slide is on screen.

props.tables: required, 1-2 of {title, head, rows}: head is a list of column names, rows a list of lists (up to 8 rows, 5 columns)
props.gold: which column is gold, counted from 1 (0 = the last)
props.title: heading
